items.context: The existing scenario has only docs/embed-protocol.md and docs/PROGRESS.md. The chore must add an API reference, a CLI reference, an operator runbook, and operational baseline values-as-docs. The documentation-health skill recommends docs/reference/, docs/guides/, docs/concepts/, and docs/internal/ subfolders with a manifest.json index.

options.label: Single combined docs/REFERENCE.md (one file covering API + CLI + embed + runbook + baseline values)
options.rationale: Lowest friction, easiest to keep up to date, single source for integrators. Trades discoverability and clutters one file.

options.label: Standard layout per documentation-health skill: docs/reference/{api.md,cli.md}, docs/guides/runbook.md, docs/concepts/embed-protocol.md (move existing), docs/internal/operational-baseline.md, plus docs/manifest.json
options.rationale: Recommended. Aligns with the documented standard, makes each surface independently discoverable in the UI shell, supports the manifest navigation that other scenarios use, scales as more docs are added.

options.label: Flat hybrid: keep docs/embed-protocol.md as-is, add docs/api-reference.md, docs/cli-reference.md, docs/runbook.md, docs/operational-baseline.md side-by-side with no nested folders or manifest.json
options.rationale: Quicker than option B, avoids moving the existing embed-protocol.md, but skips the manifest-driven UI navigation and diverges from the standard layout.

items.context: Today the emulator UI server (ui/server.js) auto-mounts /embedded/emulator/external-url via @vrooli/api-base/server — the basic 'open in new tab' URL works now. The dedicated execute/vrooli-emulator-external-url-endpoint backlog item is still in 'backlog' and is scoped to add an optional session_id query param for deep-linking. This chore does not currently list it as depends_on.

options.label: Document the existing default behavior NOW; mark the planned session_id query param as 'TBD — owned by execute/vrooli-emulator-external-url-endpoint'
options.rationale: Recommended. Covers what consumers can rely on today, sets expectations for the next iteration, doesn't block this chore on a sibling that isn't even ready yet.

options.label: Defer all external-url docs until execute/vrooli-emulator-external-url-endpoint ships; add it as a depends_on of this chore
options.rationale: Cleanest single-pass docs but blocks shipping any embed integration guidance until the sibling completes (currently still in backlog status).

options.label: Document only the existing default behavior with no forward reference to the planned deep-link param
options.rationale: Simplest, but future readers won't know the session_id deep-link is coming and may design around its absence.

items.topic: Operational baseline — values-as-docs vs negotiated limits
items.context: Code today: 1280x720 default resolution, 30s janitor check interval, 30min idle timeout, no max-session cap, no per-session CPU/memory/disk ceilings, Xvfb display range delegated to screenrecording.DisplayManager. The retired umbrella plan explicitly framed the absorbed scope as 'documentation of the defaults, not the code that enforces them'.

options.label: Document current code defaults verbatim; do not negotiate or add new limits in this chore
options.rationale: Strict reading of 'values-as-docs'. Fastest, lowest risk, but leaves the missing-cap and missing-ceiling gaps invisible to operators.

options.label: Document current defaults AND open follow-up backlog items for the missing limits (max session cap, per-session resource ceilings, explicit Xvfb range)
options.rationale: Recommended. Honors values-as-docs intent while making gaps visible and actionable. Avoids scope creep on this docs chore.

options.label: Negotiate explicit limits inside this chore: pick concrete values (e.g., max 8 concurrent sessions, Xvfb :100-:199, soft caps 25% CPU + 1GB RSS + 2GB disk per session) and document them as operational defaults
options.rationale: Most thorough. Couples docs to a real operational model, but pushes this beyond a docs chore and depends on values nobody has validated against real workloads.

items.context: scenarios/vrooli-emulator/PRD.md is the template scaffold (placeholders only). The retired umbrella absorbed scope says 'complete the Overview, Operational Targets, Tech Snapshot, Dependencies, and UX/Branding stubs'. Operational Targets are P0/P1/P2 outcome lists.

options.label: Full PRD pass: fill Overview, OT-P0/P1/P2, Tech Snapshot, Dependencies, UX/Branding with concrete content derived from the emulator-platform initiative + completed sibling work
options.rationale: Recommended. The absorbed scope explicitly named all five sections; partial fill leaves the rehoming incomplete and forces another pass later.

options.label: Fill Overview + Tech Snapshot + Dependencies + UX, leave Operational Targets as a stub for a separate product-strategy round
options.rationale: Avoids committing to outcomes without a strategy review, but contradicts the absorbed-scope wording and likely creates a follow-up item just to fill OTs.

options.label: Minimal pass: Overview + Dependencies only; everything else stays placeholder until a future round
options.rationale: Fastest, but leaves the PRD unusable as a reference for future consumers — defeats the purpose of the rehoming.

items.text: docs/embed-protocol.md already exists and accurately documents the @vrooli/iframe-bridge cross-iframe contract (envelope shape, four SessionEvent types, payload schema, versioning). This chore should integrate or reference it under whichever layout d1 picks — not rewrite it. The README.md is still the react-vite scaffold template and needs to be replaced with emulator-specific quickstart content.

plan_updates: Replaced the scope-only stub with a full 13-section scaffold (Purpose, Required Reading, Greenfield Declaration, Problem Statement, Scope, Current Technical Context, Target End State, Implementation Strategy, Contract Decisions placeholder, Testing Plan, Rollout/Validation Checklist, Risks + Mitigations, Non-goals, Definition of Done, Scenario Restart Note). Auto-added scenarios/vrooli-emulator/PRD.md to acceptance_allow so the absorbed PRD scope can be edited. Embedded discovered skills (documentation-health, api-steer, scenario-generation) as Required Reading. Sections that depend on round-1 decisions (final layout, external-url depth, baseline values, PRD OT content) left as TBD pending d1-d4.
